description: The vault catalog. Every document that reaches Ace rank — regardless of its own suit — is listed here. This is the register, not the document. The document lives in its volume; this catalog holds its address and identity.
catalog_note: A Diamond Ace is still Diamond. A Club Ace is still Club. Suit is permanent identity. This catalog is the Spade overlay — the vault register that can point to any suit's Ace.

entries.state: Diamond Jack — not yet Ace. Pre-registered. SAX entry created at christening; will activate on archival.

catalog_structure.seq_note: Sequential across all suits — not per-suit. The vault sees all suits as one register.
catalog_structure.dewey_collapse: When a document is retrieved for a specific purpose, the superposition collapses: the relevant secondary address becomes primary for that interaction. The document's identity (primary Dewey) is unchanged.

activation_states.pre_registered: Christened but still Jack — catalog entry exists, not yet activated
activation_states.activated: Diamond Ace (or suit Ace) — content locked, catalog entry live
